chunks: O believers, believe in God and His Messenger and the Book He has revealed to His Apostle, and the Books revealed before. But he who believes not in God and His angels and the Books and the prophets and the Last Day, has wandered far away.
ai.seo_question: What are the six pillars of faith mentioned in Surah An-Nisa verse 136?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to establish the continuity of divine revelation, affirming the Quran as the final and preserved scripture while validating the original forms of previous books. It underscores the necessity of believing in the 'Books' (Kutub) as a distinct pillar of faith, linking the theological concept of divine authorship to the practical acceptance of prophetic traditions.
